Script.name: aardwolf_interface.main
Script.script:
aardwolf_interface = aardwolf_interface or {}
-- State owns only validated, bounded session data and lifecycle flags. aardwolf_interface.state = aardwolf_interface.state or {}
local function finite_number(value) local number = tonumber(value) if not number or number ~= number or number == math.huge or number == -math.huge then return nil end return number end
local function bounded_number(value, minimum, maximum) local number = finite_number(value) if not number then return nil end return math.max(minimum, math.min(maximum, number)) end
local function clean_text(value, maximum_length) if type(value) ~= "string" and type(value) ~= "number" then return nil end local text = tostring(value):gsub("[%z\1-\8\11\12\14-\31]", "") if #text > maximum_length then return text:sub(1, maximum_length) .. "..." end return text end
function aardwolf_interface.state.reset_session() aardwolf_interface.state.session = { ["base"] = {}, ["vitals"] = {}, ["maxstats"] = {}, ["status"] = {}, ["stats"] = {}, ["worth"] = {}, ["room"] = {}, ["group"] = {members = {}}, ["tick"] = {}, } aardwolf_interface.state.update_count = 0 end
function aardwolf_interface.state.replace(section, value) if type(section) ~= "string" or type(value) ~= "table" then return false end aardwolf_interface.state.session = aardwolf_interface.state.session or {} aardwolf_interface.state.session[section] = value aardwolf_interface.state.update_count = (aardwolf_interface.state.update_count or 0) + 1 return true end
function aardwolf_interface.state.snapshot() if type(aardwolf_interface.state.session) ~= "table" then aardwolf_interface.state.reset_session() end return aardwolf_interface.state.session end
function aardwolf_interface.state.number(value) return finite_number(value) end
function aardwolf_interface.state.percent(value) return bounded_number(value, 0, 100) end
function aardwolf_interface.state.text(value, maximum_length) return clean_text(value, maximum_length or 160) end
-- Settings are JSON data stored below the profile even though the historical -- filename ends in .lua. Stored text is never loaded or executed as Lua. aardwolf_interface.settings = aardwolf_interface.settings or {}
local SETTINGS_SCHEMA = 1 local SETTINGS_DEFAULTS = { ["schema_version"] = SETTINGS_SCHEMA, ["visible"] = true, ["theme"] = "dark", ["border_claim"] = nil, }
local function copy_defaults() return { ["schema_version"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.schema_version, ["visible"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.visible, ["theme"] = SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.theme, ["border_claim"] = nil, } end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/aardwolf-interface" end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.path() return aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() .. "/settings.lua" end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(candidate) local validated = copy_defaults() if type(candidate) ~= "table" or candidate.schema_version ~= SETTINGS_SCHEMA then return validated end if type(candidate.visible) == "boolean" then validated.visible = candidate.visible end if candidate.theme == "dark" or candidate.theme == "high-contrast" then validated.theme = candidate.theme end local claim = candidate.border_claim if type(claim) == "table" then local base = bounded_number(claim.base, 0, 10000) local width = bounded_number(claim.width, 0, 2000) local applied = bounded_number(claim.applied, 0, 12000) if base and width and applied and applied == base + width then validated.border_claim = {base = base, width = width, applied = applied} end end return validated end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.ensure_directory() if type(lfs) ~= "table" or type(lfs.mkdir) ~= "function" then return false end local directory = aardwolf_interface.settings.directory() if type(lfs.attributes) == "function" and lfs.attributes(directory, "mode") == "directory" then return true end local ok = pcall(lfs.mkdir, directory) return ok and (type(lfs.attributes) ~= "function" or lfs.attributes(directory, "mode") == "directory") end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.load() local file = io.open(aardwolf_interface.settings.path(), "r") if file then local contents = file:read("*a") file:close() if type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_value) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(yajl.to_value, contents) if ok then aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(value) return aardwolf_interface.settings.data end end end aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(nil) return aardwolf_interface.settings.data end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.save() local data = aardwolf_interface.settings.validate(aardwolf_interface.settings.data) aardwolf_interface.settings.data = data if type(yajl) ~= "table" or type(yajl.to_string) ~= "function" then return false, "Mudlet JSON support is unavailable" end aardwolf_interface.settings.ensure_directory() local file, error_message = io.open(aardwolf_interface.settings.path(), "w") if not file then return false, error_message end local ok, contents = pcall(yajl.to_string, data) if not ok then file:close() return false, contents end file:write(contents) file:close() return true end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() return not aardwolf_interface.settings.data or aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible ~= false end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.set_visible(visible) aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible = visible and true or false return aardwolf_interface.settings.save() end
function aardwolf_interface.settings.cycle_theme() aardwolf_interface.settings.data = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme = aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme == "high-contrast" and "dark" or "high-contrast" aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme end
-- UI owns the sidebar, all widgets, the right-border claim, and mapper display. aardwolf_interface.ui = aardwolf_interface.ui or {}
local UI_PREFIX = "aardwolf-interface::ui::" local TIMER_USER = "aardwolf_interface" local RENDER_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::render" local START_TIMER = "aardwolf-interface::timer::start" local MINIMUM_WIDTH = 340 local MAXIMUM_WIDTH = 480 local WIDTH_RATIO = 0.30 local GROUP_LIMIT = 10
local THEMES = { ["dark"] = { ["panel"] = "#10141b", ["section"] = "#171d27", ["border"] = "#48566a", ["text"] = "#edf2f7", ["muted"] = "#aeb9c8", ["accent"] = "#55c2ff", ["hp"] = "#28a745", ["mana"] = "#3489eb", ["moves"] = "#d3a72f", ["enemy"] = "#d9534f", ["gauge_back"] = "#29313d", }, ["high-contrast"] = { ["panel"] = "#000000", ["section"] = "#090909", ["border"] = "#ffffff", ["text"] = "#ffffff", ["muted"] = "#e6e6e6", ["accent"] = "#00ffff", ["hp"] = "#00ff5a", ["mana"] = "#00aaff", ["moves"] = "#ffff00", ["enemy"] = "#ff3b30", ["gauge_back"] = "#333333", }, }
local function html_escape(value) local text = clean_text(value, 1000) or "" return text:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """):gsub("'", "'") end
local function display_number(value) local number = finite_number(value) if not number then return "--" end if number == math.floor(number) then return string.format("%d", number) end return string.format("%.1f", number) end
local function current_theme() local name = aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme or "dark" return THEMES[name] or THEMES.dark end
local function widget(name) return aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets and aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets[name] end
local function safe_call(object, method, ...) if type(object) ~= "table" or type(object[method]) ~= "function" then return false end return pcall(object[method], object, ...) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.message(message) echo("\n[aardwolf-interface] " .. tostring(message) .. "\n") end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.available() return type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.Container) == "table" and type(Geyser.Label) == "table" and type(Geyser.Gauge) == "table" and type(Geyser.Mapper) == "table" and type(getBorderRight) == "function" and type(setBorderRight) == "function" end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local window_width = 1200 if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, width = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(width) then return math.floor(math.max(MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(MAXIMUM_WIDTH, width * WIDTH_RATIO))) end end return math.floor(math.max(MINIMUM_WIDTH, math.min(MAXIMUM_WIDTH, window_width * WIDTH_RATIO))) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_height() if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, _, height = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and finite_number(height) then return height end end return 800 end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_border(width) local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local current = finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0 local stored = settings.border_claim local base = type(stored) == "table" and current == stored.applied and stored.base or current local applied = base + width setBorderRight(applied) settings.border_claim = {base = base, width = width, applied = applied} aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = false aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return base, applied end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.release_border() local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local claim = settings.border_claim if type(claim) ~= "table" then return true end local current = finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0 if current == claim.applied then setBorderRight(claim.base) aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = false else aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = true end settings.border_claim = nil aardwolf_interface.settings.data = settings aardwolf_interface.settings.save() return not aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.capture_mapper_owner() if aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed then return end local generic_was_shown = type(map) == "table" and type(map.configs) == "table" and type(map.configs.map_window) == "table" and map.configs.map_window.shown == true aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown = generic_was_shown aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed = true end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.restore_mapper_owner() if not aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed then return end safe_call(widget("mapper"), "hide") if aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown and type(map) == "table" and type(map.showMap) == "function" then pcall(map.showMap, true) end aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed = false aardwolf_interface.state.generic_mapper_was_shown = false end
local function new_label(name, parent) return Geyser.Label:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10}, parent) end
local function new_gauge(name, parent) return Geyser.Gauge:new({name = UI_PREFIX .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10, strict = true}, parent) end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.build() if aardwolf_interface.ui.root then return true end if not aardwolf_interface.ui.available() then return false end local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local base = aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_border(width) aardwolf_interface.ui.width = width aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right = base aardwolf_interface.ui.root = Geyser.Container:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "root", ["x"] = -(base + width), ["y"] = 0, ["width"] = width, ["height"] = "100%", }) local root = aardwolf_interface.ui.root local widgets = {} aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets = widgets widgets.background = new_label("background", root) widgets.header = new_label("header", root) widgets.room = new_label("room", root) widgets.tick = new_label("tick", root) widgets.hp = new_gauge("hp", root) widgets.mana = new_gauge("mana", root) widgets.moves = new_gauge("moves", root) widgets.tnl = new_gauge("tnl", root) widgets.enemy = new_gauge("enemy", root) widgets.stats = new_label("stats", root) widgets.group = new_label("group", root) aardwolf_interface.ui.capture_mapper_owner() widgets.mapper = Geyser.Mapper:new({ ["name"] = UI_PREFIX .. "mapper", ["x"] = 0, ["y"] = 0, ["width"] = 10, ["height"] = 10, }, root) widgets.map_status = new_label("map-status", root) safe_call(widgets.map_status, "enableClickthrough") aardwolf_interface.ui.apply_theme() aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() return true end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.apply_theme() if not aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets then return end local theme = current_theme() local panel_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", theme.panel, theme.text, theme.border) local section_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid %s; padding: 5px;", theme.section, theme.text, theme.border) local header_css = string.format("background-color: %s; color: %s; border-bottom: 2px solid %s; padding: 6px; font-weight: bold;", theme.section, theme.accent, theme.border) safe_call(widget("background"), "setStyleSheet", panel_css) safe_call(widget("header"), "setStyleSheet", header_css) for _, name in ipairs({"room", "tick", "stats", "group", "map_status"}) do safe_call(widget(name), "setStyleSheet", section_css) end local colors = {hp = theme.hp, mana = theme.mana, moves = theme.moves, tnl = theme.accent, enemy = theme.enemy} for name, color in pairs(colors) do local gauge = widget(name) safe_call(gauge, "setStyleSheet", string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", color, theme.border), string.format("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;", theme.gauge_back, theme.border), string.format("color: %s; font-weight: bold;", theme.text)) end end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() local root = aardwolf_interface.ui.root if not root then return false end local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local height = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_height() local settings = aardwolf_interface.settings.data or copy_defaults() local claim = settings.border_claim if type(claim) == "table" and (finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0) == claim.applied and width ~= claim.width then setBorderRight(claim.base + width) claim.width = width claim.applied = claim.base + width aardwolf_interface.settings.save() elseif type(claim) == "table" and (finite_number(getBorderRight()) or 0) ~= claim.applied then aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict = true end local base = type(claim) == "table" and claim.base or (aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right or 0) aardwolf_interface.ui.width = width aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right = base safe_call(root, "move", -(base + width), 0) safe_call(root, "resize", width, "100%") safe_call(widget("background"), "move", 0, 0) safe_call(widget("background"), "resize", "100%", "100%")
local margin = 8 local content_width = width - margin * 2 local header_y = margin safe_call(widget("header"), "move", margin, header_y) safe_call(widget("header"), "resize", content_width, 34) local room_y = header_y + 40 safe_call(widget("room"), "move", margin, room_y) safe_call(widget("room"), "resize", content_width - 96, 48) safe_call(widget("tick"), "move", width - margin - 90, room_y) safe_call(widget("tick"), "resize", 90, 48) local gauge_y = room_y + 56 for index, name in ipairs({"hp", "mana", "moves", "tnl", "enemy"}) do local item_y = gauge_y + (index - 1) * 28 safe_call(widget(name), "move", margin, item_y) safe_call(widget(name), "resize", content_width, 24) end local stats_y = gauge_y + 5 * 28 safe_call(widget("stats"), "move", margin, stats_y) safe_call(widget("stats"), "resize", content_width, 108) local group_y = stats_y + 116 local remaining = math.max(250, height - group_y - margin) local group_height = math.max(88, math.min(142, math.floor(remaining * 0.30))) local map_height = math.max(155, remaining - group_height - 8) safe_call(widget("group"), "move", margin, group_y) safe_call(widget("group"), "resize", content_width, group_height) local map_y = group_y + group_height + 8 safe_call(widget("mapper"), "move", margin, map_y) safe_call(widget("mapper"), "resize", content_width, map_height) safe_call(widget("map_status"), "move", margin, map_y) safe_call(widget("map_status"), "resize", content_width, map_height) if aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() then safe_call(widget("mapper"), "show") end return true end
local function gauge_value(name, current, maximum, label) local gauge = widget(name) local value = finite_number(current) local limit = finite_number(maximum) local text = label .. " " .. display_number(value) .. " / " .. display_number(limit) if value and limit and limit > 0 then safe_call(gauge, "setValue", math.max(0, math.min(value, limit)), limit, text) else safe_call(gauge, "setValue", 0, 100, text) end end
local function room_count() if type(getRooms) ~= "function" then return 0 end local ok, rooms = pcall(getRooms) if not ok or type(rooms) ~= "table" then return 0 end for _ in pairs(rooms) do return 1 end return 0 end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.render() aardwolf_interface.state.render_pending = false if not aardwolf_interface.ui.root or not aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() then return end local snapshot = aardwolf_interface.state.snapshot() local theme_name = aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme or "dark" safe_call(widget("header"), "echo", "Aardwolf Dashboard | " .. html_escape(theme_name)) local room_name = html_escape(snapshot.room.name or "Waiting for room.info") local area = html_escape(snapshot.room.area or snapshot.room.zone or "Unknown area") local vnum = display_number(snapshot.room.num) safe_call(widget("room"), "echo", room_name .. "\n" .. area .. " [" .. vnum .. "]")
local tick_text = snapshot.tick.remaining and ("Tick\n" .. display_number(snapshot.tick.remaining) .. "s") or snapshot.tick.last_seen and ("Tick\n" .. os.date("%H:%M:%S", snapshot.tick.last_seen)) or "Tick\n--" safe_call(widget("tick"), "echo", tick_text) gauge_value("hp", snapshot.vitals.hp, snapshot.maxstats.maxhp, "HP") gauge_value("mana", snapshot.vitals.mana, snapshot.maxstats.maxmana, "Mana") gauge_value("moves", snapshot.vitals.moves, snapshot.maxstats.maxmoves, "Moves") gauge_value("tnl", snapshot.status.tnl, snapshot.base.perlevel, "TNL") local enemy_name = snapshot.status.enemy and html_escape(snapshot.status.enemy) or "No enemy" local enemy_percent = aardwolf_interface.state.percent(snapshot.status.enemypct) safe_call(widget("enemy"), "setValue", enemy_percent or 0, 100, "Enemy " .. enemy_name .. (enemy_percent and (" " .. display_number(enemy_percent) .. "%") or ""))
local stats = snapshot.stats local maximums = snapshot.maxstats local worth = snapshot.worth local status = snapshot.status local stats_text = string.format( "Stats\nStr %s/%s Int %s/%s Wis %s/%s\nDex %s/%s Con %s/%s Luck %s/%s\nLvl %s HR %s DR %s Align %s\nQP %s TP %s Gold %s\nTrains %s Pracs %s", display_number(stats.str), display_number(maximums.maxstr), display_number(stats.int), display_number(maximums.maxint), display_number(stats.wis), display_number(maximums.maxwis), display_number(stats.dex), display_number(maximums.maxdex), display_number(stats.con), display_number(maximums.maxcon), display_number(stats.luck), display_number(maximums.maxluck), display_number(status.level), display_number(stats.hr), display_number(stats.dr), display_number(status.align), display_number(worth.qp), display_number(worth.tp), display_number(worth.gold), display_number(worth.trains), display_number(worth.pracs)) safe_call(widget("stats"), "echo", stats_text)
local group_lines = {"Group"} local members = snapshot.group.members or {} if #members == 0 then group_lines[#group_lines + 1] = "No group data" else for index = 1, math.min(#members, GROUP_LIMIT) do local member = members[index] local hp = member.info and member.info.hp local maxhp = member.info and member.info.mhp group_lines[#group_lines + 1] = string.format("%s L%s HP %s/%s", html_escape(member.name or "Unknown"), display_number(member.info and member.info.lvl), display_number(hp), display_number(maxhp)) end if #members > GROUP_LIMIT then group_lines[#group_lines + 1] = "+" .. tostring(#members - GROUP_LIMIT) .. " more" end end safe_call(widget("group"), "echo", table.concat(group_lines, "\n"))
if room_count() == 0 then safe_call(widget("map_status"), "echo", "Map is empty.\nRun: aard map import") safe_call(widget("map_status"), "show") else safe_call(widget("map_status"), "hide") safe_call(widget("mapper"), "show") end end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.request_render() if aardwolf_interface.state.render_pending then return end aardwolf_interface.state.render_pending = true if type(deleteNamedTimer) == "function" and type(registerNamedTimer) == "function" then deleteNamedTimer(TIMER_USER, RENDER_TIMER) registerNamedTimer(TIMER_USER, RENDER_TIMER, 0.1, aardwolf_interface.ui.render, true) else aardwolf_interface.ui.render() end end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.show(persist) if not aardwolf_interface.ui.root and not aardwolf_interface.ui.build() then aardwolf_interface.ui.message("Geyser is unavailable. Use 'aard interface status' for the text fallback.") return false end if not (aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.border_claim) then local width = aardwolf_interface.ui.panel_width() local base = aardwolf_interface.ui.claim_border(width) aardwolf_interface.ui.base_right = base end aardwolf_interface.ui.capture_mapper_owner() if persist ~= false then aardwolf_interface.settings.set_visible(true) else aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible = true end safe_call(aardwolf_interface.ui.root, "show") aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() aardwolf_interface.ui.render() return true end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.hide(persist) if persist ~= false then aardwolf_interface.settings.set_visible(false) elseif aardwolf_interface.settings.data then aardwolf_interface.settings.data.visible = false end safe_call(aardwolf_interface.ui.root, "hide") aardwolf_interface.ui.restore_mapper_owner() aardwolf_interface.ui.release_border() end
function aardwolf_interface.ui.destroy() aardwolf_interface.ui.hide(false) local root = aardwolf_interface.ui.root if root and type(root.delete) == "function" then pcall(root.delete, root) aardwolf_interface.ui.root = nil aardwolf_interface.ui.widgets = nil end end
-- Commands are explicit user-facing behavior and never send game commands. aardwolf_interface.commands = aardwolf_interface.commands or {}
local function status_line(label, current, maximum) return label .. " " .. display_number(current) .. "/" .. display_number(maximum) end
function aardwolf_interface.commands.status() local snapshot = aardwolf_interface.state.snapshot() local room = snapshot.room local lines = { "visible=" .. tostring(aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible()), "theme=" .. tostring(aardwolf_interface.settings.data and aardwolf_interface.settings.data.theme or "dark"), "room=" .. tostring(room.name or "unavailable") .. " area=" .. tostring(room.area or room.zone or "unavailable") .. " vnum=" .. display_number(room.num), status_line("HP", snapshot.vitals.hp, snapshot.maxstats.maxhp), status_line("Mana", snapshot.vitals.mana, snapshot.maxstats.maxmana), status_line("Moves", snapshot.vitals.moves, snapshot.maxstats.maxmoves), "enemy=" .. tostring(snapshot.status.enemy or "none") .. " group_members=" .. tostring(#(snapshot.group.members or {})), "tick=" .. (snapshot.tick.last_seen and os.date("%H:%M:%S", snapshot.tick.last_seen) or "unavailable"), "mapper_owned=" .. tostring(aardwolf_interface.state.mapper_claimed == true), "border_conflict=" .. tostring(aardwolf_interface.state.border_conflict == true), } aardwolf_interface.ui.message("Status:\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")) end
function aardwolf_interface.commands.show() if aardwolf_interface.ui.show(true) then aardwolf_interface.ui.message("Interface shown.") end end
function aardwolf_interface.commands.hide() aardwolf_interface.ui.hide(true) aardwolf_interface.ui.message("Interface hidden. Run 'aard interface show' to restore it.") end
function aardwolf_interface.commands.toggle_theme() local theme = aardwolf_interface.settings.cycle_theme() aardwolf_interface.ui.apply_theme() aardwolf_interface.ui.render() aardwolf_interface.ui.message("Theme changed to " .. theme .. ".") end
-- Protocol translates only known GMCP fields into bounded state. aardwolf_interface.protocol = aardwolf_interface.protocol or {}
local function numeric_fields(source, names) local output = {} if type(source) ~= "table" then return output end for _, name in ipairs(names) do output[name] = finite_number(source[name]) end return output end
local function record_and_render(section, value) aardwolf_interface.state.replace(section, value) aardwolf_interface.ui.request_render() end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_base() local source = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.base local value = numeric_fields(source, {"perlevel"}) value.name = type(source) == "table" and clean_text(source.name, 80) or nil record_and_render("base", value) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_vitals() record_and_render("vitals", numeric_fields(gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.vitals, {"hp", "mana", "moves"})) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_maxstats() record_and_render("maxstats", numeric_fields(gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.maxstats, {"maxhp", "maxmana", "maxmoves", "maxstr", "maxint", "maxwis", "maxdex", "maxcon", "maxluck"})) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_status() local source = gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.status local value = numeric_fields(source, {"tnl", "level", "align", "enemypct"}) value.enemy = type(source) == "table" and clean_text(source.enemy, 120) or nil record_and_render("status", value) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_stats() record_and_render("stats", numeric_fields(gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.stats, {"str", "int", "wis", "dex", "con", "luck", "hr", "dr"})) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_char_worth() record_and_render("worth", numeric_fields(gmcp and gmcp.char and gmcp.char.worth, {"qp", "tp", "gold", "trains", "pracs"})) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_room_info() local source = gmcp and gmcp.room and gmcp.room.info local value = {} if type(source) == "table" then value.num = finite_number(source.num) value.name = clean_text(source.name, 200) value.area = clean_text(source.area or source.area_name, 120) value.zone = clean_text(source.zone, 120) end record_and_render("room", value) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_group() local source = gmcp and gmcp.group local value = {members = {}} if type(source) == "table" then value.groupname = clean_text(source.groupname, 120) value.leader = clean_text(source.leader, 80) value.status = clean_text(source.status, 40) if type(source.members) == "table" then for _, member in ipairs(source.members) do if #value.members >= 50 then break end if type(member) == "table" then local info = type(member.info) == "table" and member.info or member value.members[#value.members + 1] = { ["name"] = clean_text(member.name, 80), ["info"] = numeric_fields(info, {"lvl", "hp", "mhp", "mn", "mmn", "mv", "mmv", "align", "tnl", "qt"}), } end end end end record_and_render("group", value) end
function aardwolf_interface.protocol.on_tick() local source = gmcp and gmcp.comm and gmcp.comm.tick local remaining = type(source) == "table" and bounded_number(source.remaining or source.seconds or source.time, 0, 3600) or source ~= nil and bounded_number(source, 0, 3600) or nil record_and_render("tick", {last_seen = os.time(), remaining = remaining}) end

function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.start_ui() if aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() then aardwolf_interface.ui.show(false) else aardwolf_interface.ui.hide(false) end end

function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.on_install(_, name) if relevant_package(name) then aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.schedule_start() end end
function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.on_uninstall(_, name) if relevant_package(name) then aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.shutdown() end end
function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.on_load() aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.schedule_start() end
function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.on_resize() if aardwolf_interface.settings.is_visible() then aardwolf_interface.ui.reflow() aardwolf_interface.ui.request_render() end end
function aardwolf_interface.lifecycle.on_connection_change() aardwolf_interface.state.reset_session() aardwolf_interface.ui.request_render() end
